_doc: How Ellie holds things (docs/griff_system.md, GripRig + AttackComponent._update_pose). styles: per item kind `edge` (the working side of the held picture: +1 its lower, -1 its upper side; it leads every swing and the tool is mirrored, never turned upside down, when it points left), `upright` (always keep the picture's top up) and three rest poses: ready (up to `ready_for` seconds after a swing or charge), carry (relaxed) and sprint. hand = where the fist goes relative to her natural hanging hand [forward, right, up] in px; dir = where the item points [degrees from her facing toward her right hand, degrees above the horizon]. The item is chosen by its `grip` key in items.json, else its `tool`, else sword. swings: per weapon class the shape of a blow in 3D: tilt = how far the plane of a forehand (from her right) leans up on her right side (0 flat sweep, 90 overhead chop), tilt_back the same for a backhand (negative = it comes down from her left: forehand and backhand cross as an X), pitch = extra degrees at the moment it passes the aim, cock / follow = radians the blade goes beyond the arc's ends before and after, over = how far it overshoots in the recovery, top_down = always from above whatever the sweep, blocks = overrides per combo block. spring: the weight of the item at rest (omega = stiffness, damping < 1 overshoots a little, inertia = how much the fist's acceleration swings the tip).
